# Pink Marker Regression Fixtures

The two PNG files are 200x185 crops of the physical sample captured locally from
camera index 0 on 2026-10-15, after the operator released the live camera.
Reference and observation are different frames from the same bounded capture.
Only the marked sample surface is retained, not the surrounding room.

These fixtures reproduce the brightness-recognition mismatch for a thin pink
cross and ring. Replacing a mark region with an unmarked surface patch exercises
a controlled absent/present sequence. That constructed sequence is not evidence
of physical movement or successful full-cycle acceptance on the machine.

Paired-cycle regressions begin with both marks visible, replace both regions with
unmarked surface, and return both marks. Additional tests transform the captured
patches by small shifts, rotations, and scales to check bounded recognition
tolerance. These image transforms do not establish physical bending tolerance.
